indicator.name: S&P 500 RSI (14-day)
indicator.description: Wilder's 14-day Relative Strength Index of the S&P 500 price index.
indicator.methodology: Wilder's RSI with a 14-period lookback, computed from daily S&P 500 closing prices. The component is contrarian: lower RSI maps to a higher score through an inverse historical percentile. Conventional 30/70 reference levels are displayed.
indicator.limitations: RSI is a price-momentum measure, not a fundamental valuation measure. It can remain oversold or overbought for extended periods. The 30/70 levels are conventions, not statistically validated thresholds.
